items.title: Document the Mechanism Placement Proof architecture and execution plan
items.context: Define the exact pre-story contract, lifecycle placement, artifact schemas, gates, freshness, story-allocation stop behavior, rollout, tests, and the B-3783 worked example. Explicitly separate candidate intake proof from PLAN verificationIntent and REVIEW/TEST/DONE evidence.

happy.desc: Inspect pre-story Mechanism Placement Proof architecture document -> contract, lifecycle placement, artifact schemas, gate definitions, freshness rules, stop behavior, rollout steps, test definitions, and B-3783 worked example are fully documented; WHY: Ensures complete pre-story proof specification.

edge.desc: Check boundary handling between pre-story intake proof vs PLAN verificationIntent and REVIEW/TEST/DONE phase evidence -> intake proof artifact remains strictly separated from post-allocation phase verification evidence; WHY: Prevents lifecycle stage confusion and evidence leakage.

adversarial.desc: Simulate missing or unverified pre-story proof artifact during story allocation attempt -> story allocation fails closed with explicit stop behavior; WHY: Guarantees Proof-or-Stop enforcement when mandatory proof is missing or invalid.

items.userSees: 用户打开 pre-story-mechanism-placement-proof-execution-plan.md，能直接看到机制定义、三种 verdict、story_create 前 no-ID gate、B-3783 示例、实施波次和测试矩阵。

verificationEvidence.note: The document includes the explicit pre-allocation artifact input and the surrounding normative architecture, rollout, touchpoints, tests, and worked example.
The audited proposal explicitly keeps intake proof candidate-only and separates it from PLAN and delivery evidence.
The gate result and test matrix require fail-closed no-ID behavior rather than error-text-only checking.

items.title: Run independent Claude CLI and agy CLI architecture audits and reconcile findings
items.context: Each CLI must independently review the complete draft for duplication, authority boundaries, bypasses, fail-closed behavior, freshness, process-fact registration, rollout safety, and test completeness. Incorporate accepted findings and record dispositions in the document.

happy.desc: Execute independent Claude CLI and agy CLI architecture audits against draft document -> both CLI audits evaluate duplication, authority boundaries, bypasses, fail-closed behavior, freshness, process-fact registration, rollout safety, and test completeness; WHY: Verifies multi-agent architectural review.

edge.desc: Reconcile conflicting audit findings between Claude CLI and agy CLI -> all accepted findings are incorporated into the document with clear disposition records for rejected findings; WHY: Ensures complete reconciliation and audit trail integrity.

adversarial.desc: Attempt to finalize architecture document with un-reconciled CLI audit findings or missing disposition records -> document verification fails validation; WHY: Prevents bypassing independent audit reconciliation controls.

items.userSees: 用户在同一方案文档的审计记录中看到 Claude CLI 与 agy CLI 的版本、独立 verdict、findings、逐项处置和最终无未解决 blocker/high 的确认。

verificationEvidence.note: The document records completed independent Claude CLI and agy audits with verified versions.
The audit section contains a single reconciliation table covering every Claude and agy finding and accepted correction.
Both focused confirmation audits returned CONFIRMED_PASS; the final audit status refuses acceptance when any blocker/high remains.

items.title: Capture Lattice host_run receipts for the Claude and agy architecture audits
items.context: The independent audits were executed through external CLI processes but Story evidence only proved that their prose was recorded. Re-run both audits through the canonical host_run choke point, attach tool-executed receipts, and add the receipt provenance to the audit record so delivery does not rely on self-authored claims.
items.userSees: 用户在方案文档中看到 Claude 与 agy 审计对应的 Lattice host_run receipt/provenance，并且 delivery reviewer 能从 Story 证据验证两次独立调用确实发生。

happy.desc: Run lattice host_run for host=claude and host=agy against the architecture-audit prompts and cite both host_run final recordIds in execution-plan section 21 -> the document cites two distinct canonical host_run final recordIds (llmuse_ prefix), one for the Claude CLI audit and one for the agy CLI audit; the Claude receipt additionally cites its provider-reported numeric usage fields since Claude's host_run final exposes a numeric usage surface, while the agy receipt honestly cites recorded=unavailable plus its exact unavailableReason (agy print mode exposes no numeric usage surface per docs/host-run-usage.md) instead of a fabricated count, replacing the prior prose-only claims; WHY: proves both audits actually ran through the canonical host_run choke point instead of resting on self-authored summaries, without demanding numeric usage from a host whose print mode structurally exposes none.

verification.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const rows=fs.readFileSync(\".lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl\",\"utf8\").trim().split(/\\n/).map(JSON.parse);const ids=[\"llmuse_e67c2062-1063-4c7e-bf33-9cef6fe90b81\",\"llmuse_681319b0-4a0d-4f17-9ba4-a5862e38e23f\"];const found=ids.map(id=>rows.find(r=>r.recordId===id));if(found.some(r=>!r))throw Error(\"missing final\");if(new Set(found.map(r=>r.ledgerCallId)).size!==2)throw Error(\"calls not distinct\");if(found.some(r=>r.storyId!==\"B-c648\"||r.phase!==\"DEV\"||r.agentType!==\"lattice-audit-mechanism-placement\"||r.sequence!==2||!r.supersedesRecordIds.length))throw Error(\"binding mismatch\");console.log(\"CHK003_HAPPY_PASS\")"

edge.desc: Any provider-reported host_run final is recorded=unavailable (e.g. agy's structurally-absent usage surface, or a Claude run with a truncated/unavailable usage line) -> the document does not fabricate a token count for that record; it cites the receipt's actual unavailable state and its exact unavailableReason, and does not treat the missing token count as proof; WHY: stops the document from overclaiming mechanical proof when a usage-ledger receipt is genuinely unavailable rather than inventing numbers to fill the gap.

verification.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const rows=fs.readFileSync(\".lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl\",\"utf8\").trim().split(/\\n/).map(JSON.parse);const c=rows.find(r=>r.recordId===\"llmuse_e67c2062-1063-4c7e-bf33-9cef6fe90b81\");const a=rows.find(r=>r.recordId===\"llmuse_681319b0-4a0d-4f17-9ba4-a5862e38e23f\");if(c.usage.source!==\"provider-reported\"||![6,1655,47054,160377].every((n,i)=>n===[c.usage.inputTokens,c.usage.outputTokens,c.usage.cacheCreationInputTokens,c.usage.cacheReadInputTokens][i]))throw Error(\"Claude usage mismatch\");if(a.usage.source!==\"unavailable\"||a.usage.unavailableReason!==\"agy_print_mode_reports_no_usage\"||a.usage.inputTokens!==null||a.usage.outputTokens!==null)throw Error(\"agy unavailable state lost\");console.log(\"CHK003_EDGE_PASS\")"

adversarial.desc: Either the Claude or the agy host_run final recordId is absent, the document's cited receipt state does not match the actual ledger state, or a numeric token count is invented for a record whose usage is recorded=unavailable -> receipt capture fails closed: the missing/mismatched/fabricated evidence is refused/blocked rather than accepted, and the document may not assert both audits are receipt-backed; WHY: guarantees the delivery-evidence replan cannot be satisfied by a missing host record, a document/ledger mismatch, or a fabricated token count standing in for agy's structurally unavailable usage surface.
